## Change and evidence

Describe the experiment or infrastructure change and link its protocol.

## Reproduction

Record commands, versions, seed blocks, metrics and negative controls.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No credentials, conversations, personal records or unlicensed third-party data.
- [ ] Train/calibration/test separation is explicit.
- [ ] Baselines receive a fair input and compute budget.
- [ ] FAIL, UNCERTAIN and superseded claims are preserved.
- [ ] Smoke and relevant full-reproduction checks completed.
- [ ] Reference data were not overwritten to hide a regression.
